nom: Amazon Basics Acne Treatment Face Wash - Daily Control Cleanser

segments.sensitive: Reports from reviewers around sensitivity are mixed: some develop severe reactions, including one who says she has never had sensitive skin before this; one reviewer with sensitive, allergy-prone, rosacea skin had a strong initial tingle and redness that resolved, after which her rashes cleared and her skin tolerated it well.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin are split: one with very oily, acne-prone skin says it burned and dried her skin out immediately, while others report it controls oil, including on the T-zone, without leaving skin dry.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers are split: several describe the wash as very drying or even burning on the skin, while a comparable number, including some who apply a moisturizer afterward, report it cleans thoroughly without drying out or stripping their skin.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers describe significant redness, puffiness, or a sunburn-like reaction, sometimes lasting into the next day; others, including one with rosacea, report their existing redness cleared up, and one reviewer had redness only on the first use that did not return.
concerns.barrier: A recurring cluster of reviewers describe severe reactions, including burning, stinging, swelling, hives, or itching, in a few cases requiring medical treatment for swollen eyes, while most other reviewers, used as directed, report no irritation at all.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report their acne, blackheads, or breakouts, including cystic acne, back acne, and rosacea-related bumps, came under control or cleared with regular use; a couple of reviewers, however, say it either did not clean their face properly or did not help their acne.
concerns.oiliness: The two reviewers who address oil control report it keeps an oily T-zone or oily, acne-prone skin balanced without leaving it dry.

extraits.texte: This is the worst skincare product I have ever used. I gave it three separate tries, and every single time my skin started itching badly and my eyes became swollen. The reaction was so severe that I had to see a doctor. My eye was in so much pain it hurt to blink and felt like it was going to burst. I was prescribed antibiotic eye drops to treat the reaction. By the time I was able to figure out what was causing the issue and seek medical help, the return window had already closed, which made the situation even more frustrating. I am not allergic to anything, but there is clearly something in this product that caused my lips, eyes, and face to burn and itch intensely. I would strongly recommend avoiding this product, especially if you have sensitive skin.

I have used multiple products over the years, but this is the first time I’ve ever had hives. I have never had “sensitive” skin but this product (and yes I did a small skin test days prior to using) caused massive stinging, burning, itching, and hives. I have enough make-up on to hide the destruction but without the make-up I looked like I was beaten. Horrible product!!!

I have very oily and acne prone skin. This picture is 10 min after my 1st use and it still burns with how bad it immediately dried out my skin! It stung a little during the washing portion but I thought it would just stop once the product was actually off my face. I was wrong. It burns!

extraits.titre: Amazing! It doesn't dry my skin. My rashes are gone.
extraits.texte: I have sensitive skin. I also have very oily skin, especially my T zone. My face has a tendency to get dry though. I have allergies to SLS, perfumes, etc. I also have rosacea. This face wash has been amazing. The very first time I used it my face did tingle a LOT and get all red. It only happened the first time though. I was running in to an issue with battling the oil and tendency to get a build up of dead skin, while trying to avoid my face being dry. I was constantly ending up with my face being uncomfortably dry, but when I would try to moisturize it to combat the dryness, I would break out in a rash and/or acne. This face wash has helped my skin so much. I'm able to wash my face to where It keeps the oil in check and gets rid of the dead skin build up, but my face is not dry. My rashes have cleared up. It is also great that it is not expensive. I have a tight budget. Pro tip, use it on your arm pits to help combat body odor. It helps kill the bacteria.

I was recently diagnosed with rosacea. I struggled with it for quite a few months. I'd have pustules, redness and scaly skin on my face. Something I'm not used to having. It made me very insecure. My dermatologist recommended an acne cleanser with benzoyl peroxide. I came across this product and figured I'd give it a try. I do not regret it! If you go by the directions on the back, you won't have any issue using it. My skin is clear. I will definitely continue buying this product! 2nd picture is after use. 3rd picture is before use.

Unfortunately, this product started to make my skin burn. I only wash my face at night with this and I use a thick moisturizer like aquaphor. I literally have to use ice cubes to attempt to cool down the burning sensation. It does bleach your towels so be careful. Also, it did lather nice and it felt like it was cleaning my skin, but sadly this doesn’t work for me and my acne.

extraits.titre: Great product. Works great to control acne
extraits.texte: So I was born with really bad skin. As soon as I hit puberty, my skin broke out in acne - BIGLY! So as a teenager I finally got it under control. Then, as I aged, the dermatologists never mentioned that acne really doesn’t totally go away when one hits adulthood and beyond. So I’ve been trying to find a decent face wash for my acne and this product is actually pretty good. It smells great and it’s not all runny. It’s thick enough and doesn’t run off my wash cloth or off my face. And it doesn’t sting my face like many acne face washes do. It doesn’t cause my skin to get red and irritated. It actually feels pretty good and moisturizes my skin. I use it every day every morning. It’s great and it’s a great price compared to fancy name-brand brands. Totally worth it!
